outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF WIND DAMAGE WILL CONTINUE ACROSS PARTS OF THE GULF COAST/SOUTHEAST UNITED STATES THIS AFTERNOON...WITH OTHER SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING ACROSS THE NORTHERN/CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS TO THE UPPER MIDWEST.

sections.title: DISCUSSION
sections.text: STORMS CONTINUE TO ORGANIZE ACROSS THE SOUTHEAST U.S. THIS AFTERNOON...IN A BAND EXTENDING FROM NRN MS EWD TO SC. A VERY MOIST/UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT HAS EVOLVED ACROSS MUCH OF THE REGION...AND AS AN UPPER TROUGH -- AND ASSOCIATED SURFACE COLD FRONT -- CONTINUE ADVANCING SWD ACROSS THE AREA...CONTINUED EXPANSION/INTENSIFICATION OF CONVECTION IS EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON. AS SUCH...AN EXPANSION OF THE SLIGHT RISK ACROSS THIS REGION...ALONG WITH ADDITION OF 30% WIND/ENHANCED RISK ACROSS PARTS OF THE AREA...ARE BEING ADDED THIS FORECAST. ELSEWHERE...ONLY MINOR CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE TO THUNDER/MRGL RISK LINES TO REFLECT CURRENT TRENDS...WITH OVERALL FORECAST REASONING FROM THE PRIOR OUTLOOK STILL VALID. ..GOSS.. 06/17/2016 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1139 AM CDT FRI JUN 17 2016/

sections.title: GULF COAST/SOUTHEAST STATES
sections.text: REGIONAL 12Z SOUNDINGS/UPPER-AIR ANALYSIS PORTRAYS A SEASONALLY COOL POCKET OF MID-LEVEL TEMPERATURES FROM THE SOUTHERN PLAINS EASTWARD TO THE ARKLAMISS /NEARLY -10C AT 500 MB AT JACKSON MS/...WITH A BELT OF MODERATELY STRONG MID/HIGH-LEVEL NORTHWESTERLY WINDS NOTED ACROSS THE TN VALLEY/SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS. A WEAK CONVECTIVELY RELATED IMPULSE IS NOTED OVER THE OZARKS/NORTHERN AR...WITH A MINORING/SOUTHEASTWARD-MOVING TROUGH OVER VA/CAROLINAS. IT SEEMS LIKELY THAT MULTIPLE CLUSTERS OF CONVECTION WILL DEVELOP/INCREASE ACROSS PARTS OF AR/MS AND CENTRAL/SOUTHERN AL...AS WELL AS PARTS OF GA/COASTAL SC THIS AFTERNOON. WHILE VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE QUITE MODEST IN MOST AREAS...STEEP LAPSE RATES/AMPLE CAPE WILL SUPPORT DIURNALLY SUSTAINED STORMS. STORM MERGERS MAY LEAD TO THE UPSCALE GROWTH OF MULTIPLE SOUTH/SOUTHEASTWARD-MOVING LINEAR CLUSTERS CAPABLE OF WIND DAMAGE AND POSSIBLY SOME HAIL. SEE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 961 FOR MORE DETAILS.

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST/MIDDLE MO VALLEY AND PLAINS
sections.text: PREVALENCE OF THE UPPER RIDGE WITH RELATED WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR/WARM MID-LEVEL TEMPERATURES WILL BE A PROMINENT FACTOR. ON THE PERIPHERY OF THE RIDGE...AN ONGOING MCS AT MIDDAY WILL CONTINUE GENERALLY EASTWARD BUT SHOULD CONTINUE TO WEAKEN AS IT ENCOUNTERS A MORE STABLE AIR MASS ACROSS NORTHEAST MN. ALTHOUGH OVERALL FORCING WILL BE QUITE WEAK...ON THE SOUTHERN FLANK OF THE CURRENT MCS...IT APPEARS PLAUSIBLE THAT ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT MAY OCCUR IN VICINITY OF OUTFLOW/SYNOPTIC FRONTAL ZONE LATER THIS AFTERNOON POTENTIALLY ACROSS PARTS OF EASTERN SD/SOUTHWEST MN/NORTHWEST IA AMID AMPLE HEATING. WHILE VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE WEAK...VERY STEEP LAPSE RATES AND ROBUST INSTABILITY /PER 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDINGS/ WILL SUPPORT A MULTI-HOUR DURATION OF INTENSE STORMS IF/WHERE THEY DEVELOP...WITH STORM MERGERS POTENTIALLY LEADING TO UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A SOUTHWARD-PROPAGATING MCS EARLY THIS EVENING. DAMAGING WINDS AND PULSE-TYPE SEVERE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE. OTHER ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS MAY DEVELOP ACROSS THE NORTH-CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS INCLUDING PARTS OF SOUTHEAST MT/EASTERN WY TO WESTERN NEB...WITH OTHER DEVELOPMENT POSSIBLE ACROSS FROM EAST-CENTRAL NEB INTO KS AND POSSIBLY PARTS OF OK.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN INTENSE STORM CLUSTER ACROSS NORTHEAST NORTH DAKOTA SHOULD CONTINUE NORTHEAST ALONG A STATIONARY FRONT INTO NORTHWEST MINNESOTA. SEVERE WIND GUSTS SHOULD REMAIN THE PRIMARY HAZARD.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 12Z ABERDEEN RAOB SAMPLED A VERY UNSTABLE AIR MASS WITH MUCAPE AROUND 3500 J/KG AMID RATHER STEEP 700-500 MB LAPSE RATES NEAR 8.5 DEG C/KM. WHILE THE ONGOING CLUSTER WILL PASS THE NORTHERN EXTENT OF THE INSTABILITY AXIS SHORTLY...THE ORGANIZED NATURE OF THE CLUSTER SHOULD RESULT IN ONLY A SLOWLY DIMINISHING RISK THROUGH LATE MORNING. GREATEST CHANCE FOR SUSTAINING SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL LIKELY BE ALONG AND JUST NORTH OF THE QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT THAT IS PRESENT FROM POLK TO BELTRAMI COUNTIES IN MN. ..GRAMS.. 06/17/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A MARGINAL STRONG TO LOW-END SEVERE GUST THREAT WILL CONTINUE. AN ADDITIONAL SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS A SQUALL LINE OVER NRN MN AND EXTENDING SWD INTO WEST N-CNTRL MN. THE LINE IS MOVING EWD BETWEEN 25-30 KT AND IT IS MOVING INTO A LESS-UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT PER OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS. NONETHELESS...THE ORGANIZED COLD POOL/ASSOCIATED MCV MAY CONTINUE TO ENABLE ENOUGH ORGANIZATION TO OVERCOME THE LIMITING POTENTIAL OF A LOW-LEVEL CAPPING INVERSION FOR STRONG TO PERHAPS LOCALLY SEVERE GUSTS TO REACH THE SURFACE. HOWEVER GOING FORWARD IN TIME...A LESSENING IN GUST POTENTIAL HAS AND WILL LIKELY CONTINUE. RECENTLY MEASURED GUST AT KFSE ONLY SAMPLED A 33-KT GUST...LIKELY INDICATIVE OF THE LOWERING SEVERE POTENTIAL. ..SMITH.. 06/17/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED CONVECTIVE INITIATION IS ANTICIPATED BETWEEN 17-19Z. SCATTERED WIND DAMAGE FROM SEVERE MULTICELLULAR STORM CLUSTERS IS FORECAST. SEVERE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS. A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH IS LIKELY ACROSS PARTS OF AL/MS BUT IT REMAINS UNCLEAR WHETHER A WATCH IS NEEDED IN GA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE IMAGERY SHOWS A SWELLING CU FIELD ACROSS NRN MS EWD ACROSS AL AND INTO NWRN GA. SURFACE OBSERVATIONS SHOW TEMPS HAVE WARMED TO THE LOWER 90S AT 16Z AND SURFACE DEWPOINTS RANGE FROM THE MID-UPPER 70S. THE 12Z RAOBS FROM JAN AND BMX EXHIBITED STRONG BUOYANCY /2500 J PER KG MLCAPE/ AND LOWEST 100-MB MEAN MIXING RATIOS 16.5-17.0 G/KG. STRONG HEATING THIS MORNING HAS PROBABLY RESULTED IN EVAPOTRANSPIRATION AND AUGMENTED MIXING RATIOS INTO THE 17-18 G/KG RANGE. FURTHERMORE...A RELATIVELY COOL H5 PROFILE RANGING FROM -10 DEG C ON THE JAN RAOB TO -8 DEG C AT FFC WILL SUPPORT LARGE HAIL GROWTH WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS. A COLD FRONT CURRENTLY ANALYZED OVER WRN TN EXTENDING ESEWD INTO NRN GA WILL PROBABLY SERVE AS A FOCUS FOR THUNDERSTORM INITIATION DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. MODIFYING THE 12Z AREA RAOBS IMPLIES LITTLE MLCINH REMAINS. ADDITIONAL HEATING WILL RESULT IN A VERY UNSTABLE BOUNDARY LAYER /MLCAPE RANGING FROM 3500-4000 J PER KG OVER MS/AL TO 3000 J PER KG OVER GA/. DESPITE ONLY WEAK TO MODEST WNW TO NNWLY TROPOSPHERIC FLOW...THE MAGNITUDE OF BUOYANCY/MOISTURE WILL LIKELY RESULT IN SEVERE MULTICELLS DEVELOPING DURING THE AFTERNOON. WATER-LOADED MICROBURSTS CAPABLE OF SEVERE-WIND GUSTS/DAMAGE ARE LIKELY LATER THIS AFTERNOON. UPSCALE GROWTH INTO ONE OR MORE CLUSTERS WILL LIKELY CONCENTRATE WIND DAMAGE SWATHS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED CONVECTIVE INITIATION IS EXPECTED OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ISOLATED TO SCATTERED WIND DAMAGE OWING TO LOWER-END SEVERE GUSTS APPEARS INCREASINGLY PROBABLE. ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL MAY OCCUR WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS THIS REGION FROM COASTAL SC INTO E-CNTRL GA HAS BEEN VOID OF CLOUD COVER LATE THIS MORNING AND THE RESULTANT HEATING HAS STEEPENED 0-2 KM LAPSE RATES. A SHORTWAVE TROUGH --EVIDENT IN WATER VAPOR IMAGERY OVER THE SRN APPALACHIANS-- IS FORECAST TO MOVE SWD INTO THE AREA LATER TODAY AND PROVIDE LARGE-SCALE ASCENT/SUPPORT FOR STORMS. SURFACE CONDITIONS S OF A COLD FRONT /ANALYZED FROM SRN COASTAL NC WWD INTO NRN GA/ HAVE WARMED TO NEAR 90 DEG NEAR THE COAST TO THE MID 90S OVER CNTRL GA. RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER 70S DEG F IS RESULTING IN A MODERATE TO VERY UNSTABLE BOUNDARY LAYER /MLCAPE 2000-3500 J PER KG/. ALTHOUGH THE MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE WEAKER COMPARED TO THE MS/AL REGION...STRONGER 2-4 KM FLOW WILL PROBABLY GLANCE SC/ERN GA. THE KCAE VAD SHOWS 30-45 KT IN THIS LAYER ATOP STEEP 0-2 KM LAPSE RATES /AROUND 9 DEG C PER KM/. WATER-LOADING AND SOME DOWNWARD MOMENTUM TRANSFER WILL LIKELY RESULT IN ISOLD TO SCATTERED WIND DAMAGE ACROSS THIS REGION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE FORECAST TO DEVELOP LATER THIS AFTERNOON. A THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS AND SEVERE HAIL WILL PROBABLY ACCOMPANY THE STRONGER STORMS. THE PROBABILITY FOR A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH APPEARS GREATEST OVER SERN AR AND ADJACENT PORTIONS OF SRN AR AND NERN LA /50 PERCENT/...WHILE A LOWER PROBABILITY SEEMINGLY EXISTS FARTHER W INTO ERN OK /20 PERCENT/.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS CU FIELD DEVELOPING OVER SERN AR EXTENDING WNWWD INTO THE OUACHITA MTNS IN SWRN AR AND SERN OK. THIS AREA IS LOCATED ALONG AND TO THE S OF A PRE-FRONTAL WIND SHIFT LOCATED FROM NRN MS WWD INTO CNTRL AR AND ARCING NWWD INTO THE BOSTON MTNS. A MCV OVER N-CNTRL AR WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO DRIFT SWD INTO CNTRL AR THROUGH THE LATE AFTERNOON. SURFACE OBSERVATIONS SHOW TEMPS HAVE WARM INTO THE LOWER 90S DEG F WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER-MID 70S. MODIFYING THE 12Z LZK RAOB FOR 18Z SURFACE CONDITIONS S OF THE PRE-FRONTAL WIND SHIFT...YIELDS AROUND 3200 J/KG MLCAPE. GENERALLY WEAK SHEAR WILL LIMIT STORM ORGANIZATION TO A MULTICELLULAR PULSE-LIKE MODE...YET THE VERY UNSTABLE AIRMASS WILL PROMOTE VIGOROUS SHORT-LIVED UPDRAFT PULSES. LIKEWISE...CONSIDERABLE WATER-LOADING IS FORECAST GIVEN LOWEST 100-MB MEAN MIXING RATIOS AROUND 16-17 G/KG AND PW IN EXCESS OF 1.5 INCHES. THE 12Z LZK RAOB ALSO EXHIBITED A RELATIVELY DRY LAYER /H85-H7/ WHICH MAY YIELD SOME EVAPORATIVE POTENTIAL. NEEDLESS TO SAY...ISOLATED TO SCATTERED STORMS ARE FORECAST TO DEVELOP AND FOCUS ALONG THE PRE-FRONTAL BOUNDARY AND NEAR STRONGER TERRAIN-INDUCED CIRCULATIONS OVER THE SWRN AR/ERN OK VICINITY. STRONG TO SEVERE MULTICELLS CAPABLE OF AN ISOLATED WIND-DAMAGE AND SEVERE-HAIL THREAT WILL PROBABLY ACCOMPANY THE STRONGER CORES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED STORMS AND/OR CLUSTERS OF STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO POSE SOME SEVERE WEATHER THREAT /STRONG WIND GUSTS AND HAIL/ ACROSS CENTRAL MN THIS AFTERNOON. ADDITIONAL CONVECTION /NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT IN EXTREME EAST-CENTRAL SD INCLUDING DEUEL COUNTY/ WILL NEED TO BE MONITORED FOR A SEVERE-WEATHER THREAT. IF CU/TCU BEGINS TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE...THEN A SEVERE TSTM WATCH MAY NEED TO BE ISSUED...GIVEN THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY ACROSS THIS REGION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN MRMS CAPPI DATA AND MESH SUGGEST STORMS ACROSS CENTRAL MN /IN OTTER TAIL TO NORTHERN TODD COUNTIES AND FROM NORTHERN KANDIYOHI TO SOUTHERN STEARNS/MEEKER COUNTIES/ HAVE BEEN WEAKENING IN INTENSITY SINCE 1840Z. THIS ACTIVITY IS LOCATED WITHIN THE SOUTHERN FLANK OF THE NORTHERN MN MCS...AS STORMS CONTINUED TO FORM/PROPAGATE TO THE SOUTH/SOUTHEAST...GIVEN WEAK SOUTHERLY LOW-LEVEL WINDS VEERING TO WEST/NORTHWESTERLY AROUND 500 MB. THE PRESENCE OF A VERY STRONGLY TO EXTREMELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS /MLCAPE OF 3000-5000 J/KG PER RAP ANALYSIS/ EXTENDING FROM THE CENTRAL MN STORMS THROUGH SOUTHWEST MN/EASTERN SD AND EASTERN NEB WILL PROVE FAVORABLE FOR ADDITIONAL STRONG UPDRAFTS WITHIN A STEEP LAPSE-RATE ENVIRONMENT. WEAK DEEP-LAYER SHEAR AND THE LACK OF STRONGER FORCING ALOFT AS THE CENTRAL MN STORMS MOVE EQUATORWARD AWAY FROM STRONGER FLOW ALOFT INTO THE UPPER RIDGE SUGGEST NEW CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT SHOULD BE FOCUSED ALONG AREAS OF ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE. THIS SCENARIO IS BEING OBSERVED IN EXTREME EAST-CENTRAL SD ALONG THE MN BORDER IN DEUEL COUNTY SD TO LINCOLN/YELLOW MEDICINE COUNTIES MN...WHERE LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE IS STRONGER IN VICINITY OF AN EASTERN SD SURFACE LOW. ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON NEAR A CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY EXTENDING FROM THE MEEKER/KANDIYOHI COUNTIES TO NORTHEAST SD AND TRAILING SOUTHWEST FROM THE LOW TO SOUTH-CENTRAL SD /CHARLES MIX AND GREGORY COUNTIES/. LOCALLY STRONG/DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL WILL REMAIN THE PRIMARY THREATS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED SWATHS OF WIND DAMAGE DUE TO STRONG/SEVERE GUSTS /50-65 MPH/ WILL CONTINUE AS CLUSTERS OF SEVERE MULTICELLS MOVE SEWD INTO THE SC COASTAL AREAS AND CNTRL GA OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL MAY ACCOMPANY THE MOST INTENSE UPDRAFTS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS A BROKEN SQUALL LINE WITH CLUSTERS OF SEVERE MULTICELLS ALIGNED FROM THE I-26 CORRIDOR N OF CHS WWD TO AGS AND W-CNTRL GA. A 51-KT GUST WAS MEASURED BY KMNI IN CNTRL SC AROUND 1915Z AND A 45-KT GUST AT KFFC NEAR ATLANTA. STRONG HEATING WITH TEMPS IN THE 95-100 DEG F RANGE HAVE RESULTED IN VERY STEEP 0-2 KM LAPSE RATES /IN EXCESS OF 9 DEG C PER KM/ DOWNSTREAM OF THE SEWD-MOVING CLUSTERS. THE 18Z CHS RAOB MODIFIED FOR CONDITIONS OVER THE SAVANNAH RIVER VALLEY/COASTAL SC YIELDS AROUND 3500 J/KG MLCAPE. A LAYER OF STRONGER FLOW /H85-H5 30-45 KT/ SAMPLED BY THE 18Z CHS RAOB WILL LIKELY PROVE FAVORABLE FOR SWATHS OF WIND DAMAGE WHERE THE STRONGER WATER-LOADED DOWNDRAFTS PUNCH THE STRONGER MOMENTUM TO THE SURFACE. FARTHER W...STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE MULTICELLS WILL CONTINUE SEWD OVER CNTRL GA WHERE TEMP/DEWPOINT SPREADS ARE AROUND 35 DEG F. SLIGHTLY WEAKER FLOW IN THE H85-H5 LAYER WILL TEND TO RESULT IN A MORE ISOLATED WIND-DAMAGE RISK COMPARED TO FARTHER E OVER SERN GA AND COASTAL SC. ..SMITH.. 06/17/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SWATHS OF DAMAGING WINDS WILL LIKELY CONCENTRATE ACROSS E-CNTRL MS INTO W-CNTRL AL. A CORRIDOR OF RELATIVELY MAXIMIZED GUST POTENTIAL MAY BE REALIZED NEAR THE MS/AL BORDER OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS A MATURE SQUALL LINE FROM N-CNTRL MS EWD INTO W-CNTRL AL. THIS LINEAR COMPLEX IS MOVING SSEWD AT 25-30 KT. A 40-KT GUST WAS MEASURED AT KGTR AT 1945Z IN NERN MS. THE AIRMASS DOWNSTREAM OF THE TSTM BAND IS CHARACTERIZED AS STRONGLY UNSTABLE PER THE 18Z BMX/JAN RAOBS /2500-3000 J PER KG MLCAPE/. DESPITE A FAIRLY MODEST WIND PROFILE...DEEP WNWLY FLOW AND AN ORGANIZED COLD POOL WILL CONTINUE TO RESULT IN THE SQUALL LINE AND RESULTANT SEVERE WIND THREAT MOVING SWD INTO E-CNTRL MS AND W-CNTRL AL OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. THE TSTM BAND APPEARS MOST ORGANIZED NEAR THE MS/AL BORDER AND IT IS SWD ALONG THE STATE BORDER WHERE A CORRIDOR OF HIGHER CONCENTRATION OF LOW-END SEVERE/DAMAGING WIND GUSTS MAY OCCUR AS THE LINE POSSIBLY ACCELERATES SLIGHTLY INTO THE WARM/UNSTABLE AIRMASS DOWNSTREAM. ..SMITH.. 06/17/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON INTO THE EARLY EVENING ACROSS CENTRAL AND SOUTHWEST NEB...PART OF CENTRAL TO NORTHWEST KS AND ADJACENT NORTHEAST CO. SINCE THE SEVERE WEATHER RISK SHOULD BE LOW...A WATCH DOES NOT APPEAR WARRANTED AT THIS TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP IN THE VICINITY OF TWO BOUNDARIES THAT EXTEND FROM NORTHEAST TO SOUTHWEST ACROSS NEB AND WITHIN A CONFLUENCE ZONE EXTENDING FROM CENTRAL TO NORTHWEST KS ALONG THE NORTHEAST PERIPHERY OF A SLOW EASTWARD-MOVING MIDLEVEL CIRCULATION INTO SOUTHWEST KS. THE NEB BOUNDARIES AND THE KS CONFLUENCE ZONE INTERSECT IN NORTHEAST CO...WITH THIS LATTER AREA ALSO BEING AN AREA FOR THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT. ALTHOUGH FORCING FOR ASCENT ALOFT AND DEEP-LAYER SHEAR ARE RELATIVELY WEAK...THE PRESENCE OF VERY STRONG INSTABILITY /MLCAPE 2500-4000 J PER KG/ AND A STEEP LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE AFOREMENTIONED LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE ZONES. TRENDS IN VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY INDICATED A FEW CBS WITH AN AGITATED CU FIELD NEAR THE SURFACE BOUNDARIES...WHILE MRMS DATA SHOWED THE STRONGEST STORMS THUS FAR IN NORTHWEST CHEYENNE COUNTY KS AND ADJACENT YUMA COUNTY CO. THE DEGREE OF AVAILABLE INSTABILITY WILL FAVOR ADDITIONAL STRONG TO SEVERE MULTICELL/PULSE-TYPE STORMS WITH LOCALLY STRONG WINDS AND SOME HAIL AS THE PRIMARY THREATS. 12Z 4-KM WRF-NSSL/WRF-NMM EACH SUGGEST AN INCREASE IN TSTM COVERAGE ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA...THOUGH OVERALL STORM INTENSITY WITH SEVERE-WEATHER THREAT REMAINS UNCERTAIN...GIVEN THE WEAK DEEP-LAYER SHEAR. HOWEVER...THE LAST SEVERAL RUNS OF THE NCEP-HRRR SUGGEST STORM MERGERS ACROSS NORTHWEST KS COULD RESULT IN A SOUTH-SOUTHEAST MOVING CLUSTER OF STORMS. TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED...AND IF GREATER COVERAGE OF SEVERE STORMS IS EXPECTED...THEN WW ISSUANCE AND OUTLOOK UPGRADE WOULD NEED TO BE CONSIDERED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN LIKELY AS STORMS DEVELOP SWWD THROUGH SWRN MN...SERN SD AND NWRN IA INTO MID EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS EXTENDS FROM ECNTRL SD INTO SWRN MN MOVING SWWD AT AROUND 25 KT...THOUGH SOME ACCELERATION ALONG PORTION OF THE LINE OVER SERN MN HAS BEEN RECENTLY OBSERVED. THE DOWNSTREAM ATMOSPHERE IS VERY UNSTABLE /3000-4000 J/KG MLCAPE/ WITH SFC TEMPERATURES IN THE LOW 90S...LOW 70S DEWPOINTS AND VERY STEEP LOW TO MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. FSD VWP INDICATES 20 KT SLY WINDS IN THE SFC-2 KM LAYER AND WILL CONTINUE TO PROMOTE SSWWD PROPAGATION DOWN THE INSTABILITY GRADIENT THROUGH SERN SD...SWRN MN INTO NWRN IA DURING THE NEXT COUPLE HOURS. STORMS ARE EMBEDDED WITHIN 25-35 KT 0-6 KM SHEAR SUPPORTIVE OF MOSTLY MULTICELLS...THOUGH SOME MARGINAL SUPERCELL STRUCTURES ARE POSSIBLE. ..DIAL.. 06/17/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: POCKETS OF STRONG/MARGINALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE THE NEXT FEW HOURS. HOWEVER...THE THREAT SHOULD GRADUALLY BECOME MORE ISOLATED WITH TIME THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LARGE BOWING CONVECTIVE SYSTEM CONTINUES TO SHIFT SOUTHWARD TOWARDS THE CENTRAL GULF COAST THIS EVENING...WITH OCCASIONAL STRONG GUSTS BEING REPORTED. WHILE OVERALL CONVECTIVE INTENSITY SHOULD GRADUALLY WANE AS OUTFLOW BECOMES INCREASINGLY DISPLACED FROM INITIATING CELLS...ENHANCED CONVERGENCE ALONG BOUNDARY INTERSECTIONS WILL PROMOTE LOCAL UPTICKS IN CONVECTION. SUCH DEVELOPMENT WILL BE ESPECIALLY FOCUSED WHERE LOW LEVELS REMAIN MORE STRONGLY HEATED/WELL-MIXED...SUCH AS ACROSS SOUTHEASTERN AL. STRONG/SEVERE CONVECTION WILL ALSO CONTINUE TO FOCUS ACROSS PORTIONS OF WESTERN MS...WHERE UPWIND DEVELOPMENT IS FOCUSED ALONG THE WESTERN FRINGE OF THE LARGER-SCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM. WHILE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR REMAINS QUITE WEAK HERE...A STRONGLY HEATED AND MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WILL MAINTAIN THE POTENTIAL FOR A FEW DAMAGING WIND GUSTS DUE TO WET MICROBURSTS. ..PICCA.. 06/17/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE GREATEST THREAT FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL FOCUS ACROSS SOUTHEASTERN GA AND FAR NORTHEASTERN FL THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WHILE TEMPERATURES HAVE COOLED INTO THE 80S ACROSS SOUTHWESTERN GA IN RESPONSE TO PREVIOUS CONVECTION...A POCKET OF STRONGER HEATING /I.E. TEMPS IN THE 90S/ AND RICH MOISTURE REMAINS OVER SOUTHEASTERN GA AND FAR NORTHEASTERN FL. WHILE THE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM TO THE NORTH IS BECOMING FARTHER DISPLACED FROM STRONGER FLOW ALOFT...INITIATING CELLS ALONG THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY MAY STILL ATTAIN AT LEAST MARGINALLY SEVERE STRENGTH. STRONG WINDS WILL REMAIN THE MAIN THREAT...PRIMARILY SUPPORTED BY HEAVY PRECIPITATION LOADING AND A VERY BUOYANT LOW-LEVEL AIR MASS. ..PICCA.. 06/17/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SOME THREAT FOR MAINLY A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL EXIST OVER NCNTRL IA THIS EVENING...BUT OVERALL THREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN TOO LIMITED FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LINE OF STORMS OVER SRN MN CONTINUES TO PROPAGATE SWD ALONG A PROGRESSIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. OVERALL TREND HAS BEEN FOR THE LINE TO BECOME LESS ORGANIZED WITH TIME WITH THE CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW SURGING AHEAD OF THE HEAVIER RAIN CORES...SUGGESTING INCREASINGLY TILTED UPDRAFTS. TEMPERATURES ACROSS NCNTRL IA ARE IN THE LOW 80S WITH MID 60S F DEWPOINTS SUPPORTING MODERATE INSTABILITY...BUT CONVECTIVE INHIBITION IS EXPECTED TO BECOME PROBLEMATIC WITH THE ONSET OF NOCTURNAL COOLING. IN THE MEANTIME...SFC OBSERVATIONS CONTINUE TO SHOW MOSTLY SUB SEVERE WIND GUSTS UP TO 45 KT...AND MARGINALLY SEVERE GUSTS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE AS ACTIVITY CROSSES INTO NCNTRL IA BEFORE FURTHER WEAKENING OCCURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO CONTINUE TO POSE A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AS THEY CONTINUE SWWD THROUGH SERN SD...NWRN IA AND INTO NE NEB THIS EVENING. AN ADDITIONAL WW MIGHT BE NEEDED SOUTH OF WW 267 TO INCLUDE NERN NEB.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CLUSTER OF STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS CONTINUES DEVELOPING THROUGH SERN SD INTO NWRN IA ALONG A SWWD MOVING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. THE DOWNSTREAM ATMOSPHERE ACROSS NERN NEB REMAINS VERY UNSTABLE WITH AROUND 3500 J/KG MLCAPE AND STEEP LAPSE RATES. CONVECTIVE INHIBITION WILL SLOWLY INCREASE THE REMAINDER OF THE EVENING. HOWEVER...THIS PROCESS MIGHT BE SLOW ENOUGH TO ALLOW ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT ALONG SWWD MOVING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY INTO NERN NEB...ESPECIALLY GIVEN THE STRENGTH OF THE COLD POOL. ..DIAL.. 06/18/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR AT LEAST ISOLATED SEVERE WIND AND HAIL SHOULD DEVELOP WITH A POTENTIALLY SOUTHWARD-ACCELERATING CLUSTER OF STORMS FROM SOUTHWEST KS. THIS REGION IS EFFECTIVELY UPGRADED TO SLIGHT AND MARGINAL RISKS THROUGH 12Z. PROBABILITY OF WW ISSUANCE IS 40 PERCENT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A RECENT INCREASE IN BOTH REFLECTIVITY AND VELOCITY TRENDS HAVE OCCURRED AS SEPARATED CELLS CONGLOMERATED ACROSS SOUTHWEST KS...JUST SOUTH OF THE DODGE CITY AREA. AIR MASS TO THE SOUTH OF THIS CLUSTER REMAINS STRONGLY UNSTABLE AMID 72-75 DEG F SURFACE DEW POINTS. SUBSTANTIAL VEERING OF THE WIND PROFILE WITH HEIGHT SUGGESTS THAT SUFFICIENT DEEP SHEAR MIGHT BE PRESENT TO SUPPORT A FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS ACROSS WESTERN OK...A SCENARIO SIMULATED IN RECENT HRRR-PARALLEL RUNS. GIVEN THE VERY STEEP 700-500 MB LAPSE RATES AROUND 8.5 DEG C/KM SAMPLED IN 00Z AREA RAOBS...THE SETUP SHOULD SUPPORT A PRIMARY RISK OF SEVERE WIND GUSTS AS WELL AS EMBEDDED AREAS OF SEVERE HAIL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: RISK FOR STRONG TO ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS SHOULD CONTINUE THROUGH AT LEAST SUNRISE. WW 269 MAY NEED TO BE LOCALLY EXPANDED SOUTHWARD IN SOUTHWEST OK.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: QLCS OVER NORTHWEST OK AND FAR SOUTHERN KS APPEARS TO BE DEVELOPING AN MCV ALONG THE EASTWARD-MOVING COMPONENT NEAR THE STATE BORDER. MEANWHILE...THE SOUTHWARD-MOVING PORTION APPROACHING THE I-40 CORRIDOR IN WEST-CENTRAL OK SEEMS MOST PROBABLE TO SUSTAIN STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS GIVEN ITS PROPAGATION COMPONENT RELATIVE TO A VERTICALLY-VEERING WIND PROFILE WITH HEIGHT. 5-9 KM MSL CAPPI REFLECTIVITY SUGGESTS THE QLCS HAS BEGUN AN OVERALL WEAKENING TREND...WHICH SHOULD RESULT IN THE SEVERE RISK SUBSIDING OVER THE NEXT 2-3 HOURS. HOWEVER...WITH APPROACH OF THE OUTFLOW NEAR THE EDGE OF WW 269...IT MAY BE PRUDENT TO EXTEND THIS WATCH A COUPLE TIERS OF COUNTIES SOUTHWARD GIVEN THE SWATH OF MEASURED SEVERE WIND GUSTS /MOST RECENTLY IN DEWEY COUNTY/. ..GRAMS.. 06/18/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE RISK HAS BECOME MINIMAL WITHIN WW 269. STRONG WIND GUSTS MAY STILL ACCOMPANY THE OUTFLOW WHICH HAS SURGED WELL TO THE SOUTHEAST OF WEAKENING STORMS OVER NORTHWEST OK.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 11Z SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACED A SURGING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM OKLAHOMA TO KIOWA COUNTIES. WHILE STRONG WIND GUSTS HAVE BEEN PREVALENT ALONG THE BOWING SHAPED PORTION OF THE SURGE /MOST RECENTLY 43 KT AT KPWA AND 42 KT AT KRQO/...IT HAS BECOME WELL SEPARATED BY ABOUT 60 MILES FROM THE WEAKENING STORM CLUSTER FARTHER NORTHWEST. THIS ACTIVITY COULD STILL PRODUCE SMALL HAIL GIVEN THE UPSTREAM INFLOW OF STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...BUT OVERALL CONVECTIVE TRENDS SUGGEST THE POTENTIAL FOR ADDITIONAL SEVERE STORMS SHOULD BE LOW THIS MORNING. ..GRAMS.. 06/18/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
